data.gender_notes: Mukarramah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'karrama' meaning 'to honor, exalt, or glorify'. In Islamic culture, it symbolizes the high status and esteem granted to someone by Allah or the community. The name Mukarramah carries the meaning “Honored, Exalted” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mukarramah usually hope their child will grow to embody honored, exalted and live with faith, good character and purpose.
